verdict.rationale: Corporations Canada's own pages say founders can submit and pay for federal incorporation through the Online Filing Centre, at $200 with a 1-day turnaround. The same pages cover annual returns and amendments filed online, with paper filing as a slower, costlier fallback. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that an end-to-end online filing actually completes.

support.subject: As a founder, the core transaction this service exists for (form, register, apply, file, or pay) can be completed online, per the service's own published pages

citations.quote: The fastest and simplest way to submit your incorporation application and pay is through our Online Filing Centre.
Federal business and not-for-profit corporations can file their annual return online.
